area_ratio.description: Measured rows: mask pixel count divided by frame area. Computed rows: box area (scaled, before rotation) divided by frame area.

bbox_px.description: Axis-aligned bbox in px [x0, y0, x1, y1].

bbox_ratio.description: Bbox as ratios [x, y, w, h].

subject.description: Element id the measured zoom_ratio follows, or null.

zoom_ratio.description: Computed non-map rows: 1 (no camera). Computed map rows: map zoom at this frame. Measured rows: subject bbox width divided by frame width, or null when the subject is absent.

centre_px.description: Anchor: element centre in px [x, y]. Null when the element is not visible or not found.

centre_ratio.description: Centre as ratios of frame width and height [x, y].

element_id.description: Stable element id, or 'unnamed:<key>' for a cluster or layer with no alias entry.

sampling.description: 'every frame' for colour rows, '0.5 s' for label-cluster rows.

tolerance.description: Computed rows: 0 (exact). Measured rows: colour tolerance in RGB units, or the luma threshold for text.

z.description: Layer order. Null only on measured rows, where z cannot be read from pixels and the alias table states no z.

description: Rows are per frame times per named element. Element identity is a stable id, shared between reference and ours through an alias table. A cluster with no alias is listed as unnamed, never silently named. Both px and ratios appear in every row, so no conversion is ever guessed. Geometry fields are null only when the element is not visible in that frame (computed rows) or not found in that frame (measured rows); the keys are always present. Camera zoom_ratio is null only when the zoom subject is absent in that frame (measured rows). z is null only on measured rows, where z-order cannot be read from pixels, unless the alias table states a z. No Math.random, no Date, no locale is used to build a ledger.

file.description: Path to the alias table file, or null for a computed build, which needs no alias table.

kind.description: scene node type, or 'colour-layer' or 'label-cluster' for measured rows.

source.description: Colour hex, layer key, or cluster key the element was measured from, when measured.

frame_end.description: Exclusive end frame: rows cover frame_start up to but not including frame_end.

colour.description: Sampling of colour-traced rows, for example 'every frame'.

labels.description: Sampling of label-cluster rows, for example '0.5 s'.

unnamed.description: Clusters or layers found with no alias entry. Each is listed, never silently named.

title: hme ledger 1.0: one JSON file per video or render, every position in px and ratios
